name: agent-sandbox
title: A sandbox for an agent, with synthetic data
summary: A clean copy of the project's agent workspace with invented data only, ready for an agent to run in. Made in seconds, on the Builder's own machine or in CI.

defaults.policy: policy/agent.rego: default deny, a person must approve what leaves the sandbox or changes the policy
defaults.audit: every action is recorded in a hash-chained log, kept in the immutable audit store when it runs on main

teardown: delete the folder: it holds nothing but a copy of the synthetic data, the plan and the policy
cost: none: it runs in a container on the Builder's machine or on a throwaway CI runner
